note: Hand-picked example ids from results.json (examples[].id = model/task), in the order the landing page plays them. Only the curation and the one-line framing live here; every question, answer, verdict and packet is read from results.json at runtime.

examples.title: Missing days
examples.why: Some days have no data. Adding up the days that are there gives a confident total that is wrong.

examples.title: New watch
examples.why: A new device starts a new baseline. Reading the two series as one invents a trend.

examples.title: Stale sync
examples.why: The watch has not synced lately. No recent nights means the answer is unknown, not no.

examples.title: HRV trend
examples.why: Night-to-night wobble reads as a slide. A fixed trend test over local days, across a clock change, says steady.

examples.title: Steps counted twice
examples.why: The phone and the watch both count the same walk. Adding the two sources double-counts.
